title.value: Responsible AI Considerations in Text Summarization Research: A Review of Current Practices
title.justification: The paper explicitly investigates responsible AI considerations in the context of text summarization research.
title.quote: Responsible AI Considerations in Text Summarization Research: A Review of Current Practices Yu Lu Liu1,2 Meng Cao1,2 Su Lin Blodgett3 Jackie Chi Kit Cheung1,2,4 Alexandra Olteanu3 Adam Trischler3 1 Mila – Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute 2 McGill University 3 Microsoft Research, Montréal, Canada 4 Canada CIFAR AI Chair

extractions.description: This paper reviews the responsible AI considerations in text summarization research, focusing on how ethical concerns and practices are addressed within the field. It analyses 333 summarization papers, primarily looking at how responsible AI issues like ethical consideration and adverse impact discussions are incorporated in the literature.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on responsible AI practices within text summarization research, which does not directly relate to climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Focusing on text summarization—a common NLP task largely overlooked by the responsible AI community—we examine research and reporting practices in the current literature.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not discuss any direct impact or application related to climate or ecological sustainable development.
primary_category.quote: AI and NLP publication venues have increasingly encouraged researchers to reflect on possible ethical considerations, adverse impacts, and other responsible AI issues their work might engender. However, for specific NLP tasks our understanding of how prevalent such issues are, or when and why these issues are likely to arise, remains limited.

secondary_categories.justification: No secondary categories related to climate or ecological sustainable development are addressed in the paper.
secondary_categories.quote: While a great deal of work on responsible AI issues has emerged for NLP broadly, much less work has addressed summarization specifically.

primary_sub_category.justification: No specific sub-categories related to the hierarchical list are covered as the paper lacks direct connection to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
primary_sub_category.quote: Focusing on text summarization—a common NLP task largely overlooked by the responsible AI community—we examine research and reporting practices in the current literature.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: There are no indirect or secondary sub-categories applicable from the predefined sustainable categories and sub-categories, given the paper's focus on ethical AI in NLP.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Specifically, we examine how authors discuss limitations of both prior work and their own work, which RAI issues they consider, the relevant stakeholders they imagine or serve, as well as how stated and realized research goals might often differ.

applications.justification: Experts are reviewing ethical considerations in text summarization but its immediate applications are not directly solving climate challenges.
applications.quote: We conduct a multi-round qualitative analysis of 333 summarization papers from the ACL Anthology published between 2020–2022. We focus on how, which, and when responsible AI issues are covered, which relevant stakeholders are considered, and mismatches between stated and realized research goals.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper's focus is neither on climate nor ecological sustainable development but rather on responsible AI practices within NLP.
new_primary_category.quote: Despite these efforts and the array of risks, little work has comprehensively examined responsible AI concerns arising from summarization systems.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: Aligned with the new primary category, the new sub-category remains non-applicable as it focuses on responsible AI.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We focus on how, which, and when responsible AI issues are covered, which relevant stakeholders are considered, and mismatches between stated and realized research goals.
